description: Column definition for TmTreeList. A non-visual component that registers a column with its parent tree list, supplying the header title, a field accessor or cell template, optional inline editing with an edit template, width, alignment, CSS class, and a .NET format string.

parameters.name: CellTemplate
parameters.description: Optional custom cell template. When set, overrides Field rendering.

parameters.name: CssClass
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to each data cell in this column.

parameters.name: Editable
parameters.description: Whether this column supports inline editing.

parameters.name: EditTemplate
parameters.description: Template rendered when the row is in edit mode. Replaces CellTemplate and Field.

parameters.name: Field
parameters.description: Field accessor that returns the cell value for a given row item.

parameters.name: Format
parameters.description: Optional .NET format string applied to the cell value (e.g. "{0:C0}").

parameters.name: HeaderTemplate
parameters.description: Custom header render fragment (replaces plain Title text when set).
